outputs.description: The agent's computed direct band gap of the pure ZnAl2O4 host. Checker compares the value to the paper-reported hidden gold within a tolerance.

The agent's computed effective band gap and mid-gap peak presence for the Ti-doped ZnAl2O4 supercell. Checker compares the effective_gap_eV to the hidden reference within tolerance and verifies mid_gap_peak_present is true.

output_contract.notes: The task omits lattice dynamics (phonon) calculations and comparison with Raman/infrared spectra because the primary code (CRYSTAL09) is not fully open-source and validation requires experimental data. Only GPAW-based electronic structure computations (band gap, density of states) are reproduced.
